This is a NEW ink-drawn graphic-novel reinterpretation of reference 1 characters for a paper surfing game, not a photographic collage or UI mockup. Blue surfboard has long cream central stripe and yellow stringer. Reference 2 supplies subtle brand vocabulary, not an advertisement.

Behind him at upper left a modest weathered navy tavern sign shows small script "Tony's" above worn condensed cream uppercase "GARRET" with a tiny palm/board badge from reference 2. Brand sign is set dressing, never headline. Background on RIGHT upper half is uncluttered pale sky and bar wall, leave this calm area for a UI speech balloon. Hero Max can appear as a small shoulder at far right edge, Tony looks toward him. Close-up faces and mug dominate, no wide establishing landscape.
